# `set_local_storage_info`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the local storage path and capacity (accepted only by one process type).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xdaad0, SetLocalDiskInfo @0x315dc0, GetDiskSpace, parse_size_G, CbConnectSlave (sender) (64-bit build) |

Only the process whose type is 2 accepts work; any other process rejects the call with 210 before reading params. It sets the first storage slot's path and size, assigns a device name and marks the storage mounted. Process type 2 is the device role that accepts a peer's storage; devices send this method to a connected secondary unit with their own disk size, so clients SHOULD NOT call it (advice INFERRED). disk_gb is binary gigabytes (GiB); the device multiplies it by 1024 and compares it with free space in MiB when computing usage. No path, positivity or capacity checks are made.

Side effects: Updates the storage slot path, stored size, device name and mounted/connected state. No timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_local_storage_info"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Required object. Other keys are ignored. Non-object or absent params yield 100 once the process check has passed. [READ] |
| `params.path` | string | yes | - | Storage path. Not validated. [READ] |
| `params.disk_gb` | number | yes | - | Capacity in binary gigabytes, GiB (float or integer; stored as a float). No range check. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | Process type is not 2 (checked before params) | `not supported` |
| 209 | path or disk_gb missing or of the wrong type | `invalid value` |
| 100 | params absent or not an object (after the process check); also the dispatcher case of a missing or non-string method | `invalid request` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |

The local-disk information setter has no tested failure branch.

## Example

Request, set - Invented path and size:

```json
{"id":61,"method":"set_local_storage_info","params":{"path":"/example/storage","disk_gb":64}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_local_storage_info","result":0,"code":0,"id":61}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_local_storage_info","error":"not supported","code":210,"id":62}
```
